classification.difficultyReason: Choose a suitable scale and apply it consistently to measured room dimensions, furniture and positions.

inlines.text: Draw a plan of your bedroom (looking down from above) showing the positions of any doors and windows, and all items of furniture.

children.label: a
children.prompt: First measure the dimensions of your room, and work out a suitable scale that will allow you to draw the plan on a page of your exercise book.

answer.short: Answers vary. Sample: a $4\text{ m}\times3\text{ m}$ room at scale $1:50$ is drawn as $8\text{ cm}\times6\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Sample room dimensions: $4\text{ m}\times3\text{ m}$. Choose scale $1:50$, so $1\text{ cm}$ represents $50\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Plan length}&=400\div50\\\text{Plan length}&=8\text{ cm}\\\text{Plan width}&=300\div50\\\text{Plan width}&=6\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
An $8\text{ cm}\times6\text{ cm}$ plan fits on an exercise-book page.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Then measure the dimensions and position of each item in the room, reduce them to scale, and draw each item on the plan.

answer.short: Answers vary. Use the same scale for every item and its distance from the walls; include all doors, windows and furniture.
answer.worked:
Continue the sample using scale $1:50$. Convert each actual measurement to centimetres, then divide by $50$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Bed length on plan}&=200\div50=4\text{ cm}\\\text{Bed width on plan}&=100\div50=2\text{ cm}\\\text{Desk length on plan}&=100\div50=2\text{ cm}\\\text{Desk depth on plan}&=50\div50=1\text{ cm}\\\text{Wardrobe length on plan}&=150\div50=3\text{ cm}\\\text{Wardrobe depth on plan}&=50\div50=1\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
In this sample, the bed touches the left and top walls. The desk touches the right wall and is $0.5\text{ m}$ from the top wall, so its top edge is $1\text{ cm}$ from that wall on the plan. The wardrobe touches the bottom wall and is $1\text{ m}$ from the right wall, so its right edge is $2\text{ cm}$ from that wall on the plan. The $1\text{ m}$ doorway and $1.5\text{ m}$ window become $2\text{ cm}$ and $3\text{ cm}$ respectively. Record the scale beside the completed plan.

spec.description: Authored example bedroom plan, not a source figure. The room is 4 m by 3 m; the complete example includes a bed, desk, wardrobe, doorway and window.
spec.mathematics: At scale 1:50 the room is 8 cm by 6 cm. Bed 4 cm by 2 cm, desk 2 cm by 1 cm, wardrobe 3 cm by 1 cm, doorway 2 cm and window 3 cm. Furniture positions agree with the worked sample.
spec.answerVisibility: Sample completed plan appears only in answers.
